metadata.title: Auto-Trading | Klarpakke - 3 Years of Testing
metadata.description: Automated trading based on 3 years of testing and hard data. No hype, just results. Start risk-free with paper trading.

hero.badge: Tested for 3 years with own money
hero.description: We spent 3 years fine-tuning our algorithms. No "Quantum AI" or magic promises – just solid math and strict risk management that works 24/7.

facts.title: Why Klarpakke?
facts.subtitle: The market is full of noise. We focus on facts.

fact1.title: 3 Years of Data
fact1.desc: We didn't launch yesterday. The algorithms have run through both bull and bear markets since 2021 to ensure robustness.

fact2.title: No "Black Box"
fact2.desc: You see exactly what happens. No hidden fees or magic formulas. You have full insight into every single trade via the dashboard.

fact3.title: Optimized for Mobile
fact3.desc: 75% of our users trade on mobile. We built the entire experience to be lightning fast and clear on your phone.

step1.title: Paper Trading
step1.desc: You get 100,000 NOK play money. Test risk-free for 30 days.

step2.title: Micro Account
step2.desc: Start with max 1,000 NOK when you feel safe.

step3.title: Scale Up
step3.desc: Increase amount gradually as you see profit.

step4.title: Full Auto
step4.desc: Let the algorithms handle your portfolio 24/7.

cta.title: Ready to test the solution?
cta.desc: It costs nothing to try Paper Trading. See for yourself why our technology is better than the market.
cta.subtext: No credit card required. Start in 1 minute.
